AT-001.name: Asset-type classification
AT-001.definition: Deterministic classifier → `asset_class` / `asset_subclass` (common stock, preferred, ADR, REIT, ETF equity/bond/commodity/leveraged/inverse, mutual fund, index, crypto coin/token/stablecoin, FX spot, commodity future/continuous, rate/macro series) from provider metadata + rules + user overrides

AT-002.name: Applicability matrix
AT-002.definition: For each analysis × asset type: applicable / adapted (different defaults) / not applicable, with reason (no fundamentals for BTC; NAV premium only for ETFs; 365-day annualisation for crypto…)

AT-003.name: Type-specific profile
AT-003.definition: Equity: company, sector, shares, listing; ETF: issuer, TER, AUM, index, holdings, replication, distribution policy; crypto: supply, market cap, rank, 24/7 calendar; FX: base/quote, rate differential; commodity: contract, roll rule; index: methodology & constituents count

AT-004.name: Type-specific risk notes
AT-004.definition: Automatic caveats (leveraged/inverse ETF decay, stablecoin peg, ADR FX exposure, delisting, low float, illiquidity, short history) shown in Overview

AT-005.name: ETF analytics
AT-005.definition: Tracking difference & tracking error vs index, premium/discount to NAV (when NAV available), holdings concentration, sector/country look-through, overlap with other ETFs

AT-006.name: Crypto analytics
AT-006.definition: 24/7 calendar handling, weekend vs weekday behaviour, correlation to Nasdaq/gold, drawdown from ATH, supply & market-cap context, stablecoin peg deviation

T-001.name: Price chart
T-001.definition: Candles, OHLC bars, line, area, Heikin-Ashi; volume pane; linear/log

T-002.name: Base-100 performance
T-002.definition: I_t = 100Π_(s≤ t)(1+r_s) rebased at visible start

T-003.name: Period returns
T-003.definition: 1D, 1W, MTD, 1M, 3M, 6M, YTD, 1Y, 3Y, 5Y, 10Y, since inception; annualised for > 1Y

T-011.name: Moving averages
T-011.definition: SMA, EMA (α=2/(n+1)), WMA, DEMA =2E_1-E_2, TEMA =3E_1-3E_2+E_3, KAMA, HMA; any period

T-012.name: MA crossover & distance
T-012.definition: Golden/death cross events; % and σ-distance of price to MA

T-013.name: Volatility bands
T-013.definition: Bollinger ( SMA± kσ), Keltner ( EMA± k ATR), Donchian; %B, bandwidth

T-030.name: 52-week range & distance
T-030.definition: Position in 52w range, % from high/low, all-time high drawdown

T-004.name: Means
T-004.definition: Arithmetic, geometric (Π(1+r))^(1/N)-1, harmonic, median, trimmed mean

T-008.name: Dispersion
T-008.definition: Range, MAD, variance, semi-variance 1/NΣmin(r-r̄,0)^2, semi-deviation, IQR

T-009.name: Rolling statistics
T-009.definition: Rolling mean, vol, skew, kurtosis for 21/63/126/252

T-010.name: OHLC volatility estimators
T-010.definition: Parkinson, Garman–Klass, Rogers–Satchell, Yang–Zhang vs close-to-close

T-014.name: Return distribution
T-014.definition: Histogram (D/W/M), Normal & Student-t MLE fits, KDE; log/simple toggle

T-016.name: Normality tests
T-016.definition: Jarque–Bera, Shapiro–Wilk (N ≤ 5 000), Anderson–Darling, D'Agostino K²; QQ vs Normal & t

T-017.name: Tail frequency
T-017.definition: Observed vs Normal-expected frequency beyond 2σ/3σ/4σ/5σ ("fat-tail multiplier")

T-018.name: Calendar returns
T-018.definition: Monthly heatmap year × month, annual bars, best/worst day/week/month/year

T-020.name: Estimate instability
T-020.definition: Rolling Sharpe with Lo (2002) SE band; bootstrap distribution of Sharpe and mean

T-021.name: Seasonality
T-021.definition: Mean/median by month, day-of-week, turn-of-month, pre-holiday; t-stats with BH-FDR flags

T-023.name: Up/down statistics
T-023.definition: % positive periods, avg up vs avg down move, longest up/down streaks, gain/loss ratio

T-024.name: Return contribution by period
T-024.definition: Share of total return earned in top 10 / 20 days ("missing the best days")

TS-001.name: Stationarity battery
TS-001.definition: ADF (lag by AIC/BIC, with/without trend), KPSS (level/trend), Phillips–Perron, Zivot–Andrews (one endogenous break); on price, log-price, returns; order of integration; rolling ADF

TS-002.name: Serial dependence
TS-002.definition: ACF/PACF of returns, |r| and r² (95 % bands), Ljung–Box Q(k), Lo–MacKinlay variance ratio (homo/hetero-robust), runs test, BDS test (non-linear dependence)

TS-003.name: Volatility clustering & models
TS-003.definition: ARCH-LM; GARCH(1,1), GJR-GARCH, EGARCH with Normal / t / skew-t innovations; persistence α+β, vol-shock half-life ln0.5/ln(α+β), unconditional vol, conditional vol series, vol forecast term structure, news-impact curve, standardised-residual diagnostics

TS-004.name: Leverage effect & vol dynamics
TS-004.definition: corr(r_t, σ_(t+k)) for k = 1…20, vol-of-vol, realised-vol regimes, vol mean-reversion half-life

TS-005.name: Long memory
TS-005.definition: Hurst (R/S with Anis–Lloyd correction, DFA), GPH log-periodogram d, variance-time plot

TS-006.name: Fractional differentiation
TS-006.definition: Fixed-width-window FFD weights w_k=-w_(k-1)(d-k+1)/(k) (τ = 1e-5) for d ∈ [0, 1]; ADF statistic and correlation with the original vs d; minimum d\* passing ADF at 95 % and memory retained (AFML-5)

TS-007.name: ARIMA dynamics
TS-007.definition: (S)ARIMA order selection (AIC/BIC grid), coefficients ± SE, residual diagnostics, impulse response; in-sample fit only (forward forecasts = V5)

TS-008.name: Decomposition & spectrum
TS-008.definition: STL trend/seasonal/residual on price, volume, macro; periodogram & Welch density; dominant cycles; wavelet variance by scale (P1)

TS-009.name: Mean-reversion / OU fit
TS-009.definition: Discrete OU / AR(1) on a level series: φ, σ, μ, half-life −ln2/ln φ with bootstrap CI and Kendall small-sample bias correction; stationary σ = σ/√(1−φ²); warning when φ̂ → 1 (AFML-13, mean formula corrected for P₀ ≠ 0)

TS-010.name: Structural breaks — CUSUM family
TS-010.definition: Brown–Durbin–Evans CUSUM on recursive residuals; Chu–Stinchcombe–White CUSUM on levels; Chow at a user date; Bai–Perron multiple breaks in mean & variance; break dates shaded on price

TS-011.name: Explosiveness / bubbles
TS-011.definition: Chow-type DF (SDFC), SADF, GSADF (Phillips–Shi–Yu), QADF, CADF, sub/super-martingale tests (SMT); bubble periods with simulated critical values (AFML-17)

TS-012.name: Regimes
TS-012.definition: Gaussian HMM (2–3 states) on returns/vol; Hamilton Markov-switching mean/variance; smoothed probabilities, transition matrix, expected durations, per-regime statistics, regime shading

TS-013.name: Entropy & information
TS-013.definition: Shannon entropy via plug-in, Lempel–Ziv, Kontoyiannis estimators on binary, quantile and sigma encodings; rolling entropy (efficiency proxy); entropy-implied vol; estimator validation on known-entropy sequences (AFML-18)

TS-014.name: Event-based sampling
TS-014.definition: Symmetric CUSUM filter events, threshold h = k·σ (rolling, no look-ahead); event counts & clustering; vs Bollinger events (AFML-2.5)

TS-015.name: Alternative bars (intraday)
TS-015.definition: Time vs tick vs volume vs dollar bars (fixed & dynamic threshold, no look-ahead), imbalance & run bars from recent 1-min data; return normality, autocorrelation, bar counts per type (AFML-2)

TS-016.name: Microstructure features
TS-016.definition: Tick rule, Roll spread, Parkinson & Corwin–Schultz spreads, Kyle λ, Amihud λ, Hasbrouck λ, VPIN (intraday buckets), PIN (P1); levels, rolling, percentiles (AFML-19)

TS-017.name: Return concentration & runs
TS-017.definition: HHI concentration of positive returns, negative returns and over time (AFML-14); up/down run lengths vs geometric null

TS-018.name: Pair dynamics
TS-018.definition: Engle–Granger & Johansen cointegration, hedge ratio (OLS, TLS, Kalman), spread z-score & half-life (TS-009), correlation vs cointegration contrast (QP-L42); trading the spread = TR-

TS-019.name: Kalman filtering
TS-019.definition: Local-level & local-linear-trend (signal/noise ratio), dynamic beta/alpha vs benchmark, smoothed states with bands

TS-020.name: Lead–lag & causality
TS-020.definition: Cross-correlation at ±k lags, Granger causality (VAR lag by AIC), transfer entropy (P1) between two series

TS-021.name: Distribution dynamics
TS-021.definition: Rolling skew/kurtosis, rolling Hill tail index, time-varying normality p-values

TS-022.name: Placebo & null simulation
TS-022.definition: For any TS-/T- statistic: observed value vs distribution under i.i.d. bootstrap, stationary block bootstrap, GBM with matched μ, σ → empirical p-value

TS-023.name: Volume & activity
TS-023.definition: Volume trend, volume–volatility correlation, abnormal volume z-score, turnover regimes

TS-024.name: Series transformations studio
TS-024.definition: Derived series (A/B ratio, spread, log, diff, frac-diff, z-score, detrended, CPI-deflated, FX-converted) usable by every TS- analysis

R-002.name: Drawdown episodes
R-002.definition: MDD; top-N table: peak, trough, recovery, depth, length, recovery time

R-004.name: Ulcer & Pain
R-004.definition: Ulcer =√(1/NΣ DD^2); Pain =1/NΣ|DD|; Martin ratio = excess CAGR / Ulcer

R-006.name: Sortino
R-006.definition: ((r̄- MAR)A)/( DD_( MAR)√ A), downside deviation over all obs

R-007.name: Calmar / Sterling / Burke
R-007.definition: CAGR/|MDD|; Sterling (avg of annual MDDs − 10 %); Burke (√(Σ DD_i^2))

R-008.name: Distribution-based ratios
R-008.definition: Omega(θ), tail ratio |q_(95)|/|q_(05)|, gain-to-pain, recovery factor, common-sense ratio, Rachev ratio

R-010.name: VaR
R-010.definition: Historical, Gaussian, Cornish–Fisher, Student-t; α ∈ [90, 99.9]; 1–20 d (√h or overlapping)

R-011.name: CVaR / ES
R-011.definition: Historical -mathbb E[rmid r≤ q], Gaussian σvarphi(z)/(1-α)-μ, CF & t variants

R-012.name: VaR backtesting
R-012.definition: Rolling 250 d VaR vs realised; exceedances; Kupiec POF, Christoffersen independence & conditional coverage; Basel traffic light

R-013.name: CAPM beta & alpha
R-013.definition: OLS on excess returns; Jensen α; R²; t-stats (Newey–West) ; Blume-adjusted β; Dimson β

R-014.name: Rolling beta / alpha / correlation to benchmark

R-015.name: Benchmark-relative set
R-015.definition: Tracking error, information ratio, Treynor, M² (Modigliani), up/down capture, batting average, relative drawdown

R-016.name: Historical stress windows
R-016.definition: Return & MDD in GFC, Euro crisis 2011, Aug-2015, Volmageddon 2018, Q4-2018, COVID 2020, 2022 rates, SVB Mar-2023, Aug-2024 carry unwind, Apr-2025 tariffs; custom windows

R-018.name: Downside capture & beta
R-018.definition: Downside beta (r_m < 0), co-skewness, co-kurtosis with benchmark

R-020.name: Risk summary card
R-020.definition: Plain-language risk sheet: vol bucket, worst day/month, MDD, VaR95 1 d in currency per 10 000 invested

R-021.name: Model-based VaR/ES
R-021.definition: GARCH-filtered historical simulation (FHS), Monte Carlo (bootstrap, Student-t, t-copula for portfolios); compared with R-010 and backtested with R-012

R-022.name: Extreme-value tail risk
R-022.definition: Peaks-over-threshold GPD with threshold diagnostics (mean-excess plot), Hill tail index, EVT VaR/ES 99–99.9 %, return levels ("1-in-10-years daily loss")

R-023.name: Drawdown distribution
R-023.definition: Distribution of drawdown depths/durations; expected max drawdown for a horizon (Magdon-Ismail approximation) and by bootstrap

F-001.name: Income statement
F-001.definition: Canonical tree; FY/Q/TTM; YoY & QoQ sub-rows; common-size % revenue

F-003.name: Cash-flow statement
F-003.definition: CFO/CFI/CFF tree; FCF, FCF − SBC derived lines

F-004.name: Income Sankey
F-004.definition: Revenue → COGS/GP → opex lines/EBIT → interest, tax/NI (+ FCF branch option)

F-006.name: Balance structure
F-006.definition: Assets vs L+E stacked columns per year

F-007.name: Debt maturity ladder
F-007.definition: Principal due Y1…Y5, thereafter (XBRL); vs cash & FCF

F-008.name: Multi-year fundamentals chart
F-008.definition: Any line items as bars + margins in aligned pane

F-009.name: Segment & geography
F-009.definition: Revenue/operating income by segment and region (XBRL dimensions, US filers), mix shift over time

F-021.name: Cash-flow bridge
F-021.definition: Waterfall from EBITDA → taxes → ΔNWC → capex → FCF → dividends/buybacks/M&A → Δnet debt

F-022.name: Statement quality checks
F-022.definition: Reconciliation status, restatements list, coverage matrix (statements × years × source)

F-010.name: Growth
F-010.definition: YoY, QoQ, CAGR 3/5/10 y of revenue, GP, EBITDA, EBIT, NI, EPS, FCF, FCF/share, BVPS, DPS; growth stability (std of YoY); share-count CAGR; organic vs reported (if segment data)

F-011.name: Margins
F-011.definition: Gross, EBITDA, EBIT, pretax, net, FCF, CFO margin; R&D %, SG&A %, SBC % of revenue; incremental margins Δ EBIT / Δ revenue

F-012.name: Returns on capital
F-012.definition: ROE, ROA, ROIC (DECISIONS D-FU-2 variants), ROCE, CROIC (FCF / invested capital), ROTE; ROIC − WACC spread

F-013.name: DuPont
F-013.definition: 3-step and 5-step decomposition with contribution chart over time

F-014.name: Liquidity
F-014.definition: Current, quick, cash ratio, defensive interval, operating cash-flow ratio

F-015.name: Solvency & leverage
F-015.definition: Total & net debt (with leases), D/E, D/Capital, D/Assets, ND/EBITDA, ND/FCF, interest coverage (EBIT & EBITDA), FCCR, equity multiplier

F-016.name: Efficiency
F-016.definition: Asset & fixed-asset turnover, DSO, DIO, DPO, CCC, working capital % revenue

F-017.name: Cash generation & quality
F-017.definition: CFO, capex, FCF, FCF − SBC, FCF/NI, CFO/NI, capex/revenue, capex/D&A, Sloan accruals

F-018.name: Capital allocation
F-018.definition: Dividends, payout (NI, FCF), DPS growth, consecutive years of increase, gross/net buybacks, shareholder yield, net debt issuance, M&A spend, reinvestment rate, sustainable growth g=b· ROE

F-019.name: Per-share
F-019.definition: EPS basic/diluted, BVPS, TBVPS, FCF/share, sales/share, DPS, cash/share

F-025.name: Sector-specific KPIs
F-025.definition: Banks: NIM, cost/income, CET1 (when filed), loan/deposit; Insurers: combined ratio; REITs: FFO, AFFO, payout; Software: Rule of 40, ARR proxy; Retail: inventory turns

S-001.name: Health scorecard
S-001.definition: 5 pillars (Growth, Profitability, Balance sheet, Cash flow, Valuation*) 0–100; blend 70 % absolute thresholds / 30 % own-history percentile; sector threshold sets; full drill-down. *Valuation pillar uses V-001/V-002 from J7; until then the pillar shows "available with valuation (J7)"*

S-003.name: Altman Z / Z″
S-003.definition: Auto variant, zones; hidden for financials

S-005.name: Screen flags
S-005.definition: Quality (ROE > 15 %, D/E < 0.5, GM > 40 %), value (EV/FCF < 15), cash quality (FCF/NI > 1.2) — descriptive flags with rule text

S-006.name: Montier C-score
S-006.definition: 6 binary signals: NI–CFO gap widening, DSO up, DIO up, other current assets/revenue up, depreciation/PP&E down, total assets growth > 10 %

S-007.name: Earnings-quality dashboard
S-007.definition: Accruals (balance-sheet & cash-flow), CFO/NI trend, DSO vs revenue growth divergence, inventory vs sales, capitalised costs ratio, one-off items frequency

S-008.name: Dividend safety score
S-008.definition: Payout (NI & FCF), FCF coverage, ND/EBITDA, dividend growth streak, earnings volatility → 0–100

S-010.name: Interest-rate & refinancing exposure
S-010.definition: Floating-rate debt share (if filed), maturities next 24 m vs cash + FCF

V-001.name: Current multiples
V-001.definition: P/E (TTM, NTM if estimates), EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT, EV/Sales, P/FCF, EV/FCF, P/B, P/TBV, P/S, PEG, dividend/FCF/earnings yields; EV = mkt cap + debt + leases + pref + minorities − cash & ST inv.; mkt cap = price × current share count (≤ 400 d old), cross-checked vs net income ÷ diluted EPS (±20 %, multi-class issuers; spec 274)

V-002.name: PIT historical multiples
V-002.definition: Daily multiple series using facts with `filed_at ≤ t`; mean ± 1σ, percentiles 10/50/90 over 5/10 y

V-010.name: WACC builder
V-010.definition: E/V k_e + D/V k_d(1-τ); CAPM / build-up; bottom-up β (peer unlevered median relevered, Hamada); ERP & country premium editable

V-011.name: DCF
V-011.definition: FCFF (default) / FCFE / APV; 1/2/3 stages; mid-year; Gordon & exit-multiple TV; EV→equity bridge; per-share value; implied multiples check; reinvestment via sales-to-capital

V-012.name: Reverse DCF
V-012.definition: Solve implied growth (and implied margin) for current price

V-014.name: Residual income
V-014.definition: V_0 = B_0 + Σ ((ROE_t - k_e)B_(t-1))/((1+k_e)^t) (default model for banks/insurers)

V-015.name: Earnings power value
V-015.definition: Greenwald EPV = adjusted EBIT(1−τ)/WACC; franchise value = market EV − EPV

V-016.name: Football field
V-016.definition: Low–high ranges per method (DCF, peers multiples, own-history multiples, DDM/RI, 52 w range, analyst targets labelled third-party) vs current price

V-017.name: Sensitivity & scenarios
V-017.definition: 2-D sensitivity (WACC × g, margin × growth); bear/base/bull scenarios; Monte Carlo on assumptions (triangular/normal) → distribution of value per share

V-018.name: Market-implied expectations
V-018.definition: Implied ROIC/growth pairs consistent with current EV (iso-value curve)

V-019.name: Sum-of-the-parts
V-019.definition: Segment EBITDA × user multiples (segment data from F-009 or manual) − net debt

V-020.name: Valuation history vs fundamentals
V-020.definition: Price vs EPS/FCF per share (both base 100) — "multiple expansion vs earnings growth" decomposition of return: R = Δ EPS + Δ(P/E) + dividends

PE-001.name: Auto peer group
PE-001.definition: Algorithm D-PE-2 (industry, size band, return correlation, margin similarity) → ranked candidates with scores

PE-002.name: Manual peer group editing
PE-002.definition: Pin/remove/add; freeze; reset to auto; named groups reusable

PE-003.name: Comps table
PE-003.definition: Any F-/V- metric for subject + peers; median, mean, percentile rank, z-score; calendarised option

PE-004.name: Relative valuation
PE-004.definition: Implied value from peer median multiples (EV/EBITDA, P/E, EV/Sales, P/FCF); regression P/E vs growth or EV/Sales vs margin across peers

PE-005.name: Operating benchmarking
PE-005.definition: Growth, margins, ROIC, leverage vs peers: scatter maps (e.g. ROIC vs growth, EV/EBIT vs ROIC)

PE-006.name: Sector dashboard
PE-006.definition: Aggregated sector fundamentals (median margins, growth, multiples) and sector ETF performance vs market

PE-007.name: Peer price behaviour
PE-007.definition: Correlation, relative performance, beta to peer basket

E-001.name: Earnings calendar & history
E-001.definition: Past & next report dates, EPS/revenue actual vs consensus (third-party data, labelled)

E-002.name: Surprise statistics
E-002.definition: Surprise %, beat rate, standardised unexpected earnings (SUE)

E-003.name: Earnings event study
E-003.definition: Cumulative abnormal return (market model) −5…+20 days around reports; average path; gap statistics

E-004.name: Estimate trends
E-004.definition: EPS/revenue estimate revisions (7/30/60/90 d) and dispersion when provider supplies them

E-005.name: Analyst views (third-party)
E-005.definition: Consensus rating distribution & targets displayed as data with source/date; never re-labelled as app opinion

E-006.name: Implied vs realised earnings move
E-006.definition: Needs DV-010 (J15) — slot reserved, filled in V3

O-003.name: Insider activity
O-003.definition: Form 4 transactions (US): buys/sells, net insider value 3/6/12 m, cluster buying flag; non-US where provider supplies

O-004.name: Short interest
O-004.definition: Shares short, % float, days to cover, trend (provider-dependent, US)

O-005.name: Share count & dilution
O-005.definition: Basic/diluted shares history, buyback execution vs authorisation (if filed), SBC dilution rate

O-006.name: Liquidity profile
O-006.definition: ADV (20/60 d, value), turnover, Amihud illiquidity, bid-ask proxy (Corwin–Schultz), days to trade X % ADV

TA-001.name: Momentum oscillators
TA-001.definition: RSI, StochRSI, Stochastic %K/%D, Williams %R, CCI, ROC, momentum, Ultimate oscillator

TA-002.name: Trend indicators
TA-002.definition: MACD (+ hist), ADX/DMI, Aroon, Parabolic SAR, SuperTrend, Ichimoku, linear-regression channel

TA-003.name: Volatility
TA-003.definition: ATR, NATR, Chaikin volatility, historical vol cone (also DV)

TA-004.name: Volume
TA-004.definition: OBV, A/D line, Chaikin money flow, MFI, volume oscillator, VWAP (session & anchored), volume profile (price × volume histogram, POC, value area)

TA-005.name: Candlestick patterns
TA-005.definition: TA-Lib CDL family (≈ 60) with occurrence markers and historical forward-return statistics (descriptive, BH-FDR)

TA-006.name: Chart patterns
TA-006.definition: Heuristic detectors: double top/bottom, H&S, triangles, flags, cup & handle — labelled "heuristic"

TA-007.name: Levels
TA-007.definition: Support/resistance by swing clustering, pivots (classic/Fibonacci/Camarilla), Fibonacci retracements/extensions on chosen swing

TA-008.name: Relative strength
TA-008.definition: RS line vs benchmark & sector ETF, Mansfield RS, RS rank in watchlist

TA-009.name: Multi-timeframe
TA-009.definition: Same indicator on D/W/M with alignment table; higher-TF values use previous closed bar only

TA-010.name: Intraday bars
TA-010.definition: 1 m–1 h bars (provider limits apply: yfinance ≈ 7–60 d history) for VWAP & intraday studies

TA-011.name: Technical summary table
TA-011.definition: All indicators' current states in one dense table (value, zone, slope) — no buy/sell aggregation

TA-012.name: Z-score & mean distance
TA-012.definition: Price z-score vs MA_n, Hurst-based regime hint (from Q-008 when available)

P-001.name: Weights mode
P-001.definition: Target weights, rebalancing assumption (D-PF-2), drift, costs bps

P-004.name: MWR / XIRR
P-004.definition: IRR of dated external flows + terminal value

P-005.name: Positions & P&L
P-005.definition: Qty, avg cost (FIFO/PAMP/LIFO), MV, unrealised/realised P&L, day change, weight, holding period

P-006.name: Allocation breakdowns
P-006.definition: Asset class, sector, industry, country, region, currency, market-cap bucket, style (from SC factor ranks in V3)

P-007.name: Concentration
P-007.definition: Max weight, top-5, HHI, effective N

P-008.name: Contribution to return
P-008.definition: Σ_t w_(i,t-1)r_(i,t), cumulative and by period

P-009.name: Risk decomposition
P-009.definition: Euler: RC_i = w_i(Σ w)_i/σ_p; marginal contribution; risk vs weight share

P-017.name: Turnover & costs
P-017.definition: Turnover under the rebalancing assumption, cost drag

P-018.name: Brinson attribution
P-018.definition: Allocation, selection, interaction effects by sector vs benchmark (Brinson–Fachler), multi-period linking (Carino)

P-019.name: Look-through fundamentals
P-019.definition: Portfolio-level P/E (harmonic), EV/EBITDA, ROIC, margins, growth, ND/EBITDA, dividend yield, health score distribution

P-020.name: Currency exposure
P-020.definition: Exposure by currency (listing & revenue-geography proxy), FX contribution to return

P-021.name: Liquidity of portfolio
P-021.definition: Days to liquidate x % at y % ADV per line and total

P-022.name: Historical scenario replay
P-022.definition: Apply crisis windows (R-016) to current weights

P-023.name: Factor-shock scenarios
P-023.definition: Shocks to SPX, 10y yield, USD, oil, HY spread → Δvalue via betas (multi-factor regression)

P-024.name: Income analysis
P-024.definition: Dividend/interest received history, forward 12 m income from current yields, yield on cost, income by line

P-025.name: Active share & tracking
P-025.definition: Active share vs benchmark ETF holdings; ex-ante tracking error

P-026.name: Holdings overlap
P-026.definition: Overlap between portfolios / with ETFs (look-through when holdings available)

C-003.name: Stress correlation
C-003.definition: Worst-10 % benchmark days vs all days

C-004.name: Risk–return map
C-004.definition: Vol vs CAGR, bubble = weight, iso-Sharpe

C-005.name: Correlation stability
C-005.definition: Sub-period matrix difference, top changed pairs

C-007.name: Tail dependence
C-007.definition: Empirical lower-tail co-crash frequency for pairs

CP-001.name: Comparison set
CP-001.definition: 2–8 subjects of any type (asset, portfolio, benchmark, later strategy); KPI matrix with best-per-row; overlays (base-100, drawdown, rolling Sharpe/vol); calendar grid; correlation of subjects; stress windows

CP-002.name: Benchmarks
CP-002.definition: Presets (S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, MSCI World/ACWI, STOXX 600, CAC 40, AGG, GLD, BTC, 60/40, 80/20 EUR), blended custom benchmarks with rebalancing, portfolio-as-benchmark

CP-003.name: Peer-group of portfolios
CP-003.definition: Rank a portfolio within a set (percentile of CAGR/Sharpe/MDD)

CP-004.name: Report builder

TR-018.name: Carver forecast engine
TR-018.definition: Rules with published scalars, each scaled to mean |F| ≈ 10 and capped ±20: EWMAC (8/32, 16/64, 32/128, 64/256; ÷ σ in price units), breakout (40/80/160/320-day range position, smoothed), acceleration (EWMAC change over its fast span), skew (−rolling skew 60/120/240). Within-rule FDMs 1.13/1.17/1.55/1.18; rule weights 0.15/0.15/0.15/0.20 normalised to 1; combined FDM = 1/√(w′Cw) on floored correlations, cap 2.5, point-in-time (expanding, monthly); vol = 0.7·EWMA σ(30) + 0.3·its 5-y mean; weight = F/10 · τ/σ, long-only, cap 1, 10 % buffer, warm-up 260. Diagnostics vs buy & hold and vol-targeted buy & hold (the no-trend benchmark), Sharpe SE √((1+SR²/2)/T), stress windows, DSR/PBO over the template grid. Template `carver_trend` in TR-010

TR-019.name: Prop-firm challenge Monte Carlo
TR-019.definition: Two phases (+10 %, +5 %), daily loss 5 %, total loss 10 % of the initial capital, ≥ 4 days, 250-day horizon per phase; OOS daily net returns block-bootstrapped (20 d), rescaled to each vol target; P(funded), P(fail in phase 1), median days. Close-to-close (optimistic vs intraday checks). v1.1.0 CFD costs: spread (bp) on each change of position, swap per calendar night held (annual rate, long/short; the triple-swap day only moves the charge within the week), no exchange fees

TR-024.name: Robustness protocol
TR-024.definition: Quant Rick's corrected protocol on a strategy. Plateau selection on in-sample Sharpe only: score = median IS Sharpe of the cell and its grid neighbours (one step per axis); eligible = ≥ 2 round trips a year and off the grid's edge when an inner cell exists; pick = best score (ties → own IS Sharpe); OOS Sharpe shown read-only. Execution delay: chosen parameters at close t+1, t+2, t+3 and the adjusted open of t+1 (open-to-open returns, two-bar shift). Two epochs fixed in advance (`epoch_split`, default the middle of the post-warm-up sample), each against buy & hold, the vol-targeted buy & hold (TR-018) and the MA200 filter: Sharpe ± √((1+SR²/2)/T), CAGR, MaxDD; epoch < 1 year → null + reason. Ablation: each Carver rule (weights renormalised), the buffer and each overlay switched off; a layer earns its place when removing it lowers the Sharpe in both epochs. Checks pass/warn/n-a: plateau, trades a year (n/a for continuous sizing, turnover shown), delay (Sharpe at t+2 ≥ ½ Sharpe at t+1), both epochs beat the vol-targeted hold, layers. v1.1.0 option `letf_baseline`: 50/50 of the index bought and held and a simulated daily-reset ×3 ETF (r₃ = 3r − (fee + 2·financing)/periods, fee 0.88 %, financing 4 % by default) held above its own 200-day average, rebalanced daily; check = beats it on Calmar in both epochs. Annualisation from the series' bars per year

TR-025.name: Signal ensembles & shadow test
TR-025.definition: Members = the k best in-sample cells of the strategy's grid (k = 5 by default). Combined by OR (any long), AND (all long), majority vote (> ½ long) and mean (average position). Shadow test (Boruta-style): the series' own position path rotated in time by a random offset (≥ 63 bars from both ends), n = 200, seed 1, same costs; p = (1 + #shadows with Sharpe ≥ actual)/(n + 1) on in-sample bars; beats its shadows at p ≤ 0.05. OOS Sharpe and MaxDD shown read-only

TR-026.name: Multi-asset Carver book
TR-026.definition: Subject portfolio: its non-cash holdings are the instruments, its weights (renormalised) the instrument weights. Each instrument sized by TR-018 on its base-currency total-return index at the book's vol target (default 20 %, buffer 10 %). Position_i = IDM · w_i · p_i; IDM = 1/√(w'Hw) on the correlations of sub-system returns p_(i,t−1)·r_(i,t), negatives floored at 0, cap 2.5, point-in-time (expanding, monthly, ≥ 252 obs); gross exposure capped (default 2). Engine: one-bar shift, costs = portfolio cost_bps on traded notional, warm-up 261. Compared with the basket bought and held (static weights) and the basket sized by vol without trend (same IDM method): Sharpe ± SE, CAGR, vol, MaxDD, exposure, two epochs, crisis windows; per-instrument sub-system Sharpe. No parameter fitted
TR-026.source: QT bootcamp 2, owner's review (diversify across assets)
